mechanism: 锁定同一成年动画厨师、暖光厨房、蔬菜、刀具、炒锅、餐盘与食客；原料依次经历切开、混合、加热、熟化和装盘等不可逆状态，厨师把同一份成品沿连续路线递交，最后由同一成年食客的第一口反应证明完成。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult chef, one workspace, one ingredient set, one cutting tool, one heated vessel, one plate and one adult diner remain bound.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult chef, one workspace, one ingredient set, one cutting tool, one heated vessel, one plate and one adult diner remain bound."

invariants.rule: Each beat performs one irreversible food-state operation and preserves visible material traces from the prior state.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each beat performs one irreversible food-state operation and preserves visible material traces from the prior state."

invariants.rule: Prepared ingredients enter the same heated vessel and cannot reset to whole raw form after cooking begins.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Prepared ingredients enter the same heated vessel and cannot reset to whole raw form after cooking begins."

invariants.rule: The plated food carried through the route is the same cooked batch proven in the wok.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The plated food carried through the route is the same cooked batch proven in the wok."

invariants.rule: The final adult tasting reaction occurs only after handoff and keeps the remaining dish visible as completion evidence.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final adult tasting reaction occurs only after handoff and keeps the remaining dish visible as completion evidence."

slots.name: lead_subject

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
